**Finding submitted: `missing` (confidence 0.9)**

The agreement has no post-termination transition or data-return provision. Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) covers only access wind-down (10.1) and Deliverable delivery/refunds (10.2). Notably, Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to "Sections 11 and 15" — but Section 11 does not exist in the document, and Section 15 addresses only processing restrictions, not return or deletion. Searches for "transition assistance," "export," and "delete" confirm the gap.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** New Section 10.3 inserted after p0042 requiring Vendor, on expiry or termination for any reason, to (a) provide up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, (b) return Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data and certify deletion in writing. Fallback of 90 days' assistance flagged in the comment while preserving the 30-day export and deletion certification.
